s.how: Cut 600g lamb shoulder into strips and marinate in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill on high until charred. Wrap small pieces in torn warm pita with sliced tomato, onion and a spoon of garlic yoghurt, then pin with toothpicks.

s.note: a bowl on the coffee table at the Cody house
s.how: Slice 3 onions thinly and cook in butter over low heat for 40 minutes until deep golden. Cool, then fold through 300ml sour cream and 125g softened cream cheese with chopped chives and salt. Chill for an hour and serve with a big bowl of ridged potato chips.

m.how: Halve 2 chicken breasts and crumb them in flour, egg and panko. Shallow fry until golden and cooked through. Top with sliced ham, a spoon of crushed tomato simmered with garlic, and grated mozzarella. Grill until bubbling and serve with hot chips and a green salad.

w.how: Bake 2 puff pastry sheets flat between trays at 200C until crisp. Whisk 750ml milk, 3 eggs, 150g sugar and 80g cornflour over heat until very thick. Spread between the sheets in a lined tin. Ice with icing mixed with passionfruit pulp, chill overnight and cut.

d.n: Melbourne pub lemon, lime and bitters
d.note: a cold one at the local pub
d.how: Fill 4 pot glasses with ice. Add 20ml lime cordial, the juice of a quarter lemon and 4 good dashes of aromatic bitters to each. Top with cold lemonade, stir once and add a lemon wedge. A pot of cold lager on the side for anyone after one.
